question: Which of the following initiatives of the Ministry of Minority Affairs received the prestigious India International Trade Fair, 2021 Silver Medal for strengthening commitment to 'Vocal for Local' in November of 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hunar Haat**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hunar Haat**, an initiative of the Ministry of Minority Affairs, received the **Silver Medal at the India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2021** for its contribution to the 'Vocal for Local' campaign.
 
• It promotes and showcases traditional arts, crafts, and culinary skills of artisans and craftsmen from across India, particularly from minority communities.
 
• **Theme of IITF 2021:** *Aatma Nirbhar Bharat* (Self-reliant India).
 
• It has empowered over **8 lakh artisans, craftsmen, and culinary experts** since its inception.
 
• The initiative has gained popularity not just domestically but also globally, with plans to expand markets for Indian artisans internationally.
 
• Events organized under Hunar Haat serve as platforms for cultural exchange, emphasizing unity in diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ATAL Innovation Mission (AIM)
 
 
• The ATAL Innovation Mission is a flagship initiative by NITI Aayog aimed at promoting innovation and entrepreneurship across India.
 
• It focuses on fostering innovation in schools, colleges, and the start-up ecosystem through initiatives like Atal Tinkering Labs and Atal Incubation Centers.
 
 
 
• AMRIDH Scheme
 
 
• The SAMRIDH (Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development, and Growth) Scheme was launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) to provide financial support, mentorship, and market access to start-ups.
 
• It primarily targets tech-based start-ups and aims to develop innovative products and services.
 
 
 
• ASPIRE
 
 
• ASPIRE (A Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries, and Entrepreneurship) is an initiative of the Ministry of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) to promote rural entrepreneurship through the development of agro-industry and rural enterprises.
